sql: SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2008 GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Commercial Case' AND case_number >= 3 GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India') GROUP BY case_family
SELECT first_judge, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Civil Case' AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2008 GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' AND nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE legal_basis_num >= 3 AND defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family
SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE first_judge = 1 AND evidence = 1 AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE hearing_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2008 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY verdict_family

SELECT CASE WHEN case_number >= 10 THEN 'many_precedents' ELSE 'fewer_precedents' END AS precedent_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Civil Case' AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY precedent_band

SELECT CASE WHEN plaintiff_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') THEN plaintiff_current_status WHEN plaintiff_current_status != '' THEN 'Individual_or_other' END AS plaintiff_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE verdict = 'Approved' AND plaintiff_current_status != '' GROUP BY plaintiff_family
SELECT judge_name, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND verdict = 'Dismissed' GROUP BY judge_name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE defendant_current_status = 'Government' GROUP BY case_family
SELECT evidence, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE legal_basis_num BETWEEN 2 AND 5 AND case_number >= 4 GROUP BY evidence

SELECT CASE WHEN nationality_for_applicant IN ('Australia', 'China', 'India', 'Bangladesh') THEN nationality_for_applicant WHEN nationality_for_applicant != '' THEN 'Other' END AS applicant_nation, AVG(legal_basis_num) AS avg_statutes FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Administrative Case' AND nationality_for_applicant != '' GROUP BY applicant_nation
SELECT judgment_year, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type = 'Commercial Case' AND legal_basis_num >= 2 AND judgment_year BETWEEN 2006 AND 2009 GROUP BY judgment_year

SELECT CASE WHEN verdict IN ('Dismissed', 'Approved', 'Others') THEN verdict ELSE 'Other' END AS verdict_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE plaintiff_current_status = 'Company' AND defendant_current_status IN ('Company', 'Organization', 'Government') GROUP BY verdict_family
SELECT first_judge, AVG(case_number) AS avg_precedents FROM legal WHERE hearing_year >= 2007 AND hearing_year <= 2009 AND case_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY first_judge

SELECT CASE WHEN defendant_current_status IN ('Government', 'Company', 'Organization') THEN defendant_current_status WHEN defendant_current_status != '' THEN 'Other' END AS defendant_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE verdict IN ('Approved', 'Others') AND defendant_current_status != '' GROUP BY defendant_family

SELECT CASE WHEN legal_basis_num >= 4 THEN 'statute_heavy' ELSE 'statute_light' END AS statute_band, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE case_type IN ('Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') GROUP BY statute_band

SELECT CASE WHEN case_type IN ('Administrative Case', 'Civil Case', 'Commercial Case') THEN case_type ELSE 'Other' END AS case_family, COUNT(*) AS case_count FROM legal WHERE evidence = 0 AND first_judge = 1 GROUP BY case_family
